description: Butterfly Effect Cascade Intelligence — models how a shock in one macro domain propagates through the interconnected web of climate, geopolitical, economic, and commodity systems. Given an origin event and a magnitude score, returns a time-ordered cascade chain showing which downstream systems are hit, in what sequence, with what attenuated signal strength, and an AI synthesis briefing. Covers 24 nodes across 4 domains. Call with listNodes:true first to discover valid origin IDs.

eventType.description: Free-text description of the specific event (e.g. "Russia-Ukraine escalation", "Sahel drought season", "Fed emergency 75bps hike").

horizonHours.description: Forward time horizon in hours (1–720). Default: 168 (1 week).

listNodes.description: If true, returns all valid origin node IDs and descriptions instead of running a cascade.

magnitude.description: Shock magnitude 1–100. 100 = maximum plausible shock for this event type.

origin.description: Origin node ID. Call market.cascade with listNodes:true to discover valid IDs (e.g. "geo.conflict", "climate.drought", "commodity.oil", "macro.rate_decision").

name: market.cascade
